scope: Confirmed source indexing, original quotations, structural boundaries and handoff; not Chinese runtime acceptance

checks.name: All confirmed selections are indexed with separate reviewed and parent-only evidence levels
Every indexed Chinese value and quoted range comes directly from the pinned original text
Japanese, qid and original-source lookups round-trip to identical link identities
The reviewed A-button display range never brings the unobserved save-completed prefix with it
Pokedex second pages point to existing whole Japanese parents and never create NULL Japanese or inferred spans
Stale Japanese, changed original Chinese, invalid ranges, cross-game links and approval flags fail closed
Changed index maps or Chinese cannot bypass validation; rejected semantic homonyms stay out
Established command-line queries expose associations without silently approving new translations
The correspondence compiler is reproducible and rebuilds the exact saved index
Reverse review preserves its frozen cohort, deferred decisions and separate review provenance
Reviewed Japanese fragments isolate units, interjections and mutually exclusive move-learning branches
Partial source links stay out of whole-record coverage and cannot publish a translation
S6 handoff retains the index without publishing it and loads without upstream files
